# The Hanging of Judas

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** The Hanging of Judas
- **Artist / Maker:** Alsatian or Southern German
- **Date:** c. 1520
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** stained glass/leaded glass
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 65795
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/65795
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/9ffb5b78-7db0-864e-c0c1-d54a55d706e4/full/400,/0/default.jpg
